title: 南陵别儿童入京
titlePy: Nán Líng Bié Ér Tóng Rù Jīng
titleEn: Leaving My Children at Nanling for the Capital
author: 李白
intro: At forty-one Li Bai finally gets the call he has waited for all his life: the emperor wants him at court. This is his explosion of joy — home-brewed wine, roast chicken, dancing children, and the famous last line: “Laughing up at the sky, I walk out the door.”
analysis: 公元742年，唐玄宗召李白进京。李白等这一天等了很多年，于是写下这首痛快淋漓的诗。前三联写家里的欢乐：秋天新酿的白酒熟了，黄鸡吃饱了黍米正肥，诗人叫童仆杀鸡斟酒，孩子们笑着拉住他的衣服；他高声唱歌、喝得大醉，起身跳舞，好像要和落日比一比光彩。后三联写心里的志向：他怪自己没能早点去游说君王，现在要赶紧扬鞭上马走远路；又用朱买臣的典故——朱买臣穷的时候被妻子看不起，后来做了大官——暗暗说那些小看自己的人看错了。最后“仰天大笑出门去，我辈岂是蓬蒿人”，意思是：我们这样的人，怎么会一辈子埋没在草野之中！全诗由家里的小场面写到天下大志，感情层层升高，最后一句冲到顶点，是李白最有个性的诗句之一。
analysisEn: In 742 Emperor Xuanzong summoned Li Bai to the capital. Li Bai had dreamed for years of doing great things for the empire, and when the call finally came he wrote this burst of joy. The first three couplets are a family celebration. The new autumn wine is ready, the yellow hens are plump from pecking millet; he calls the servant boy to cook a chicken and pour the wine, and his children laugh and tug at his clothes. He sings, drinks himself merry, and dances as if competing with the setting sun for brightness. The last three couplets turn to ambition. He regrets not going to persuade the emperor sooner, and now he will whip up his horse and take the long road. Then an allusion: Zhu Maichen, a poor scholar of the Han dynasty, was abandoned by his wife for being a failure, then rose to become a governor. Li Bai is hinting that people who looked down on him were wrong. The final line is one of his most famous: “Laughing up at the sky, I walk out the door — are people like me meant to stay among the weeds?” From a small scene at home to the largest ambition, the feeling rises couplet by couplet until it peaks in that last proud shout.
background: Li Bai (701–762) was summoned to the court of Emperor Xuanzong in 742, at about forty-one. He wrote this on leaving his home — traditionally placed at Nanling (in today’s Anhui), though some scholars put it in Shandong, where his children lived. His time at court would last less than two years.
pronunciation: 游说 yóu shuì（不读 shuō）；万乘 wàn shèng（指君王）；著鞭 zhuó biān；会稽 kuài jī（不读 huì）；啄 zhuó；黍 shǔ；蓬蒿 péng hāo。机器朗读“游说”“万乘”“著”“会稽”容易读错，已在“朗读用字”列替换同音字，音频需人工听验。
version: 采用通行本，全诗六联十二句。“白酒新熟山中归”一作“白酒初熟山中归”。题中“南陵”所在有争议，一说在今安徽，一说在今山东。

lines.zh: 白酒新熟山中归，黄鸡啄黍秋正肥。
lines.rhythm: 白酒/新熟/山中归，黄鸡/啄黍/秋正肥
lines.py: bái jiǔ xīn shú shān zhōng guī, huáng jī zhuó shǔ qiū zhèng féi
lines.lit: The white wine is newly ripe, I return from the hills; yellow chickens peck millet, in autumn just plump.
lines.en: The new wine is ready as I come down from the hills, and the hens, fat on autumn millet, peck in the yard.

lines.zh: 呼童烹鸡酌白酒，儿女嬉笑牵人衣。
lines.rhythm: 呼童/烹鸡/酌白酒，儿女/嬉笑/牵人衣
lines.py: hū tóng pēng jī zhuó bái jiǔ, ér nǚ xī xiào qiān rén yī
lines.lit: I call the boy to cook a chicken and pour white wine; sons and daughters laugh and pull at my clothes.
lines.en: I call the boy to roast a chicken and pour the wine; my children laugh and tug at my sleeves.

lines.zh: 高歌取醉欲自慰，起舞落日争光辉。
lines.rhythm: 高歌/取醉/欲自慰，起舞/落日/争光辉
lines.py: gāo gē qǔ zuì yù zì wèi, qǐ wǔ luò rì zhēng guāng huī
lines.lit: Singing loudly, getting drunk, I want to comfort myself; rising to dance, I compete with the setting sun for brightness.
lines.en: I sing out loud and drink to my heart’s content, then dance, outshining the setting sun.

lines.zh: 游说万乘苦不早，著鞭跨马涉远道。
lines.rhythm: 游说/万乘/苦不早，著鞭/跨马/涉远道
lines.py: yóu shuì wàn shèng kǔ bù zǎo, zhuó biān kuà mǎ shè yuǎn dào
lines.lit: To persuade the lord of ten thousand chariots — sadly not early enough; I raise the whip, mount the horse, and cross the long road.
lines.en: My only regret is not going sooner to advise the emperor — now, whip in hand, I ride out on the long road.
lines.tts: 游税万胜苦不早，酌鞭跨马涉远道。

lines.zh: 会稽愚妇轻买臣，余亦辞家西入秦。
lines.rhythm: 会稽/愚妇/轻买臣，余亦/辞家/西入秦
lines.py: kuài jī yú fù qīng mǎi chén, yú yì cí jiā xī rù qín
lines.lit: The foolish wife of Kuaiji looked down on Maichen; I too leave home and go west into Qin.
lines.en: The foolish wife of Kuaiji scorned poor Zhu Maichen; I too say goodbye and head west for the capital.
lines.tts: 快稽愚妇轻买臣，余亦辞家西入秦。

lines.zh: 仰天大笑出门去，我辈岂是蓬蒿人。
lines.rhythm: 仰天/大笑/出门去，我辈/岂是/蓬蒿人
lines.py: yǎng tiān dà xiào chū mén qù, wǒ bèi qǐ shì péng hāo rén
lines.lit: Looking up at the sky, laughing loudly, I go out the door; how could people like us be people of the weeds?
lines.en: Laughing up at the sky, I walk out the door — were men like me born to stay among the weeds?

words.note: 地点有争议，一说在今安徽，一说在今山东。
古诗里指自己的子女；今天“儿童”泛指小孩。
一种黄米，现代北方还种。
现代汉语“斟酌”本义就是倒酒。
读 shuì；现代也说，如“游说议员”。

words.en: the lord of ten thousand chariots; the emperor
words.note: “乘”读 shèng，指兵车，古代以此代称天子。

words.en: to apply the whip; to set off quickly
words.note: 古语，“著”读 zhuó，现代不用。
汉代朱买臣，穷时被妻子抛弃，后来做了会稽太守。

words.en: to go west into Qin (to Chang’an)
words.note: 秦地指长安一带，这里是“去京城”。
现代书面语“岂有此理”“岂敢”。
古诗里比喻没有官职、默默无闻的人。

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 新酒、斟酒、醉酒，酒是诗人狂喜心情的放大器。
imagery.en: New wine, wine poured, wine drunk — wine amplifies the poet’s wild joy.

imagery.name: 夕阳
imagery.zh: 起舞和落日“争光辉”，写出诗人意气风发、光芒四射的自信。
imagery.en: Dancing to outshine the setting sun shows his soaring, dazzling confidence.

imagery.name: 马
imagery.zh: 扬鞭跨马踏上远路，象征他奔向理想的急切。
imagery.en: Whipping up his horse for the long road shows how eager he is to chase his dream.
